### INC curriculum reconciliation and verified primary reference leads

- [INC 2020 B.Sc. Nursing Gazette curriculum](https://thc.nic.in/Central%20Governmental%20Regulations/Indian%20Nursing%20Council%20%28Revised%20Regulations%20and%20Curriculum%20For%20B.Sc.%28Nursing%29%20%28Program%29%20Regulations%2C2020..pdf): extracted text inspected, Adult Health Nursing unit IX includes disaster preparedness, emergency management, polytrauma, bites, toxic exposure, temperature emergencies and medico-legal issues. Unit XI covers critical-care organization, staffing, equipment, ACLS and transitional care. Printed page 324 and following table. PDF screenshot request failed. Reconcile the full unit before claiming coverage.
- [WHO/ICRC Basic Emergency Care](https://www.who.int/publications/i/item/9789241513081): official HTML opened, topic slides listed as updated December 2025, including initial ABCDE/SAMPLE assessment, trauma, breathing, shock, altered consciousness and transfer/handover. Detailed slide content review pending.
- [WHO Interagency Integrated Triage Tool](https://www.who.int/tools/triage): official HTML opened, routine adult/pediatric and facility mass-casualty tools distinguished. Do not mix routine acuity categories with surge-specific protocols or prehospital systems. Individual algorithms still need item-level review.
- [AHA 2025 adult BLS](https://cpr.heart.org/en/resuscitation-science/cpr-and-ecc-guidelines/adult-basic-life-support): official HTML opened, 2025 guidance supersedes prior full guidelines unless specified. Covers recognition, emergency activation, CPR, AED and airway obstruction. Use role-specific recommendations and current local protocols. Detailed item-level validation pending.
- [WHO mass casualty management](https://www.who.int/teams/integrated-health-services/clinical-services-and-systems/emergency-and-critical-care/mass-casualty-management): official HTML opened, clinical forms, trauma checklist, tracking and surge tools identified.
